ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left of the figure is an amide fragment bearing an R1 acyl group, and the structure can be read as R1-C(=O)-NH-CH2-C(=O)OH, namely an amino acid-like carboxylic acid substrate. On the right is acetic anhydride, CH3-C(=O)-O-C(=O)-CH3. The curved arrows show the hydroxyl oxygen of the carboxylic acid on the left attacking the acetyl carbonyl carbon on the left side of acetic anhydride; the π electrons of this carbonyl are pushed onto the carbonyl oxygen, then the oxyanion pushes back to form the carbonyl, while the middle C-O bond in acetic anhydride breaks and the acetate on the right is generated as the leaving group. Reasoning: These arrows correspond to formation of a mixed anhydride from the carboxylic acid and acetic anhydride. In the original substrate R1-C(=O)-NH-CH2-C(=O)OH, the carboxylic acid end is converted to R1-C(=O)-NH-CH2-C(=O)-O-C(=O)-CH3; the other leaving acetyl half becomes acetate CH3-C(=O)O−. Represent R1 with wildcard [*], and the product SMILES is [*]C(NCC(OC(C)=O)=O)=O.CC([O-])=O.

method.method_draft: First describe the diagram: the amino-acid-like carboxylic acid attached to an R1 amide attacks acetic anhydride, and the arrows show addition to one acetyl carbonyl followed by elimination of acetate. Convert this into bond changes: replace the substrate carboxylic OH bond state with a mixed anhydride linkage, R1C(=O)NCC(=O)OC(=O)CH3, and generate acetate anion, CH3C(=O)O−, from the leaving acetyl group. Translate R1 as [*] to produce [*]C(NCC(OC(C)=O)=O)=O.CC([O-])=O.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中左侧是一个带 R1 酰基的酰胺片段，结构可读作 R1-C(=O)-NH-CH2-C(=O)OH，即氨基酸样羧酸底物。右侧是乙酸酐，CH3-C(=O)-O-C(=O)-CH3。弯箭头显示左侧羧酸的羟基氧进攻乙酸酐左边的乙酰羰基碳；该羰基的 π 电子推到羰基氧上，随后氧负离子回推形成羰基，同时乙酸酐中间的 C-O 键断裂，右侧乙酸根作为离去基团生成。推理：这些箭头对应羧酸与乙酸酐形成混合酸酐。原底物的 R1-C(=O)-NH-CH2-C(=O)OH 中，羧酸端转化为 R1-C(=O)-NH-CH2-C(=O)-O-C(=O)-CH3；离去的另一半乙酰基成为乙酸根 CH3-C(=O)O−。把 R1 用通配符 [*] 表示，产物 SMILES 为 [*]C(NCC(OC(C)=O)=O)=O.CC([O-])=O。
